english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately behaving in a challenging or provocative way.

examples.english: They always speak to people confrontationally, making the whole room awkward.
examples.traditional: 佢成日好挑釁咁同人講嘢，搞到成間房都好尷尬。
